programme.desc: In Kakadu National Park, Andy joins Dewayne Webb foraging pandanus and cooking Seared Buffalo with Pandanus & Charred Herb Salsa over an open fire. He then heads to Darwin, assisting Zach Green at Elijah’s Kitchen, a food truck offering indigenous-inspired meals like Magpie Goose and Crocodile Laksa. Returning to Kakadu, Andy goes fishing with local Barramundi expert Rob Johnson and prepares Paperbark Leaf BBQ Barramundi with Sour Tamarind Sauce at Anbangbang Billabong, showcasing the region's environment and produce.

programme.title: E8 - Axis Deer
programme.desc: Yia travels to Texas to hunt arguably the tastiest of all deer. Native to India, the Axis deer were introduced in Texas in 1932 as a prized game meat for ranchers. The Texas hill country turned out to be the perfect habitat for Axis deer, who quickly escaped their high fence ranches, establishing a healthy wild breeding population. Now with over 150,000 Axis deer roaming the hill country, these deer are competing with native white tail deer for resources. Local rancher Chris Hughes has a solution- a mobile harvesting trailer where he culls wild Axis deer from overpopulated farms. Chris will show Yia how harvesting this species has become a full-time business and delicious solution.

programme.title: Darna Mana Hai
programme.desc: Seven friends, after their car breaks down in the middle of the night, find shelter and tell one another stories to kill time till dawn. Release Year: 2003 Director: Prawaal Raman Awards: 2004 Winner Reader's Choice- Best Supporting Actor- Boman Irani

programme.title: Kaala Patthar
programme.desc: Vijay Singh is a disgraced former navy officer who is branded as a coward and forced to work at a coal mine out of guilt. However, he gets trapped with other miners after a flood hits them. Release Year: 1979 Director: Yash Chopra

programme.title: The Hill of Secrets
programme.desc: Sensitive 12-year-old Myung-eun (Moon Seung-a) is embarrassed of her working-class family and constantly lies to keep her true family situation a secret. When she writes, though, she is not constrained by reality. Pouring herself into essays, Myung-eun takes pride in constructing a different world of her own. However, the candid writings of a new student shake her sense of self, and prompt Myung-eun to better understand her family. Reminiscent of acclaimed coming-of-age Korean indies like The World of Us and House of Hummingbird, writer-director Lee Ji-eun's understated debut feature excels in its perceptive depiction of the emotions and experiences of a child trying to find her place in the world.

programme.title: 13 Hours: The Secret Soldiers Of Benghazi
programme.desc: A true story of six elite ex-military operators who face overwhelming odds when terrorists attack a U.S. diplomatic compound in Benghazi, Libya.

programme.title: Living With Lincoln
programme.desc: This documentary examines how a one-of-a-kind collection of Abraham Lincoln photos and memorabilia have shaped the lives and sensibilities of five generations of his family.
